title: Scenario record
description: One intervention scenario. All scenarios are simulated for the same patients, so their results can be compared patient by patient.

scenario_id.title: Scenario
scenario_id.description: Unique identifier of the scenario. The reference scenario without intervention is usual_care.

risk_adapted_start.title: Risk-adapted start
risk_adapted_start.description: A risk prediction at therapy start flags patients at high risk, whose start of therapy is adapted.

symptom_monitoring.title: Symptom monitoring
symptom_monitoring.description: Weekly symptom reports with alerts are offered to all patients during therapy.

lung_monitoring.title: Lung monitoring
lung_monitoring.description: Home monitoring for lung toxicity is offered to patients on a regimen with this risk.
